find.match_belief: I was drawn to the entertainment industry because of its crossover with tech and business. Good ideas become experiences that genuinely connect with people! I love being part of the work behind the scenes that brings those moments to life, and I believe entertainment has a unique ability to inspire and add something meaningful to everyday life.

profile.belief: I know it's not everyone's first choice of a favorite movie, but it's mine because it's the film that got me into entertainment. The movie was released when I was in 7th grade, and it impacted me as a coming-of-age film. I realized Tom Holland's character just wanted to be heard and help others, and I wanted to do the same. Now, since that film created that impact for me, I want to do it for others.
profile.working_on: I want to direct, for sure. I love the ability to not only have creative control over the story but also to lead talent. I find it very enjoyable working through a scene as if I were in front of the camera and talking through the best way to portray the characters for that particular piece.
